meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 这是一个只读的 GitHub 分诊工具。你让它分析时，它会查看所有未关闭的 issue 和 PR，逐个在后台分析，并把带证据链接（permalink）的报告写入 /tmp 临时目录；它绝不会在 GitHub 上发表评论、合并、关闭或打标签。
howto.when: 当你说出“triage”、“triage issues”等关键词，或要求对 GitHub 仓库进行分诊时触发。

say.note: 它会把所有未关闭的 issue 分析成报告写到 /tmp。
它会把所有未关闭的 PR 分析成报告写到 /tmp。
它会同时对 issue 和 PR 做分诊。

howto.what_en: Read-only GitHub triage for issues and PRs. Analyzes all open items, spawns one subagent per item, writes evidence-backed reports with GitHub permalinks to /tmp/{datetime}/. No GitHub mutations — no comments, merges, closes, labels.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like "triage", "triage issues", "triage PRs", or "github triage". Then analyzes all open issues and PRs.

say_en.note: It will analyze all open issues and write reports to /tmp.
It will analyze all open PRs and write reports to /tmp.
It will triage both issues and PRs.
